acceptanceCriteria: A failing-test run receipt carries the advisory test-source findings anchored to that test, with rule id, file:line and the named replacement
When lint evidence is absent at the revision, the receipt states NOT_PRODUCED with a reason instead of omitting the field
Exit status is unchanged by advisory findings; a fixture test covers both the present and absent cases; the spec records the requirement
body: Residual from V1-1769 (PR #1119, GitHub #1114). The issue asked that advisory findings such as one-shot-ui-state-assertion and exact-text-cross-variant appear in the run receipt beside a failing test, so the agent reading a failure sees that the assertion is a one-shot UI read or an exact-text cross-variant mismatch. V1-1769 delivered them only in `corvint tests lint` output, because the run receipt had no small hook. Expected: a run receipt for a failing test lists the advisory lint findings anchored to that test (rule, location, replacement) with their resolution state, and reports NOT_PRODUCED with a reason when lint did not run at the revision. Advisory findings must not change exit status (TSA-V0-016).
title: tests run receipt does not show advisory test-validity findings next to the failure (residual of #1114 / V1-1769)
